_comment: All non-ASCII UI text lives here, never inside a .ps1. Windows PowerShell 5.1 mis-parses a .ps1 that contains non-ASCII without a UTF-8 BOM (silent no-match, or TerminatorExpectedAtEndOfString). This file is read with an explicit UTF-8 decoder, so it has no such hazard. It also makes the whole skill retargetable to another MAA UI language by editing one file.
